{{Top|leg}}
The '''basket hilt''' was an enhanced [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] for [[Vibroblade/Legends|bladed]] weapons that had basket-shaped guard for the hand, making the augmented weapon ideal for parrying, but slightly unwieldy. This hilt had been available in two versions, advanced and superior.
